title: AMFI Investor Guide: Direct Plans vs Regular Plans in Mutual Funds
source: Association of Mutual Funds in India (AMFI)
content: Mutual fund schemes offer two plan options: Direct Plans and Regular Plans. Direct Plans are purchased directly from the AMC or digital platforms without distributor involvement, carrying no distributor commission and lower Total Expense Ratio (TER). Regular Plans are bought through mutual fund distributors or brokers, carrying embedded trail commissions. Consequently, Direct Plans consistently yield slightly higher NAVs and compounding returns over long investment horizons.
